latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of saas-indie-hacker-coach.

- Provides comprehensive coaching for solo and micro-SaaS founders, focusing on validation, MVP scoping, distribution, and growth.
- Designed to trigger on common indie hacker and SaaS-related phrases and use-cases.
- Guides through all key phases: idea validation, ICP definition, MVP scoping (no-code, low-code, or code), pricing/packaging, launch strategy, distribution, pricing experiments, churn diagnosis, hiring, transitions, exits, and founder sustainability.
- Includes detailed diagnostic questions and anti-pattern warnings to optimize founder success.
- Explicitly rejects engagement with unethical or scammy SaaS schemes.
